$comment: Phase 21 acceptance definition derived from architecture/phase-21-global-cloud-fabric.md, the phase contract, cloud-core/cloud-byoc/cloud-governance modules, infrastructure definitions and the cloud/infrastructure unit suites. Infrastructure verifier evidence proves repository invariants and credential gating, not a provisioned environment.

ownership.note: Phase 21 owns region/environment topology, BYOC registrations, placement policy and cloud governance. It does not own domain data, sovereign policy packs or planetary infrastructure.

areas.area: Infrastructure plans and placement are provider-neutral
areas.requirement: Regions, providers, deployments and placement plans carry declared capabilities and zones, and plans require explicit approval before application.

areas.area: BYOC registration has trust, permissions, health and revocation
areas.requirement: BYOC environments require an issuer and trust establishment, explicit permission manifests, health state and reasoned revocation.

evidence.contains: returns unknown when control plane disconnected

areas.area: Cloud governance models health, incidents, cost and recovery
areas.requirement: Health, SLO, alert, incident, runbook, cost, break-glass, migration, exit and kill-switch records are explicit governance objects.

areas.area: Infrastructure-as-code is verified for containment and neutrality
areas.requirement: The fabric verifier checks infrastructure digests, secrets, remote state, pinned versions, cluster baseline, sandbox containment, neutrality and ownership without duplicating domain engines.

evidence.contains: passes every recorded invariant across all nine law categories

areas.area: No cloud environment is claimed as deployed
areas.requirement: Provisioning remains behind reviewed IaC and owner credentials; verifier evidence records the gate and does not prove that apply has occurred.

evidence.contains: states its own limitations and what remains credential-gated
